chunks: And you are not a guide to the blind against their misguidance; you only make hear those who believe Our signs, so they are Muslims.

key_terms.الْعُمْيِ: the blind (metaphorically for those lacking spiritual insight)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Prophet's role in conveying guidance and God's role in granting it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse clarifies the distinction between the Prophet's duty of proclamation (tabligh) and God's exclusive power to grant guidance (hidayah), affirming that belief requires internal acceptance of divine signs. It underscores the principle that while the Prophet conveys the truth, the actual submission (islam) is a divine gift bestowed upon those who respond to the ayat, reinforcing the concept of divine grace alongside human responsibility.
